original_report: mean sensor reading divides by zero when no samples are present.
diagnosis: An empty sequence must return the documented zero mean.
patch_diff:
--- a/target.py
+++ b/target.py
@@ -1,3 +1,5 @@
 def mean_reading(samples):
     count = len(samples)
+    if count == 0:
+        return 0
     return sum(samples) / count
